headline: Forget expensive sleepbuds. Buy this pillow instead
summary: This article critiques overpriced sleepbuds from tech companies. It suggests a speaker pillow as a cost-effective alternative. The pillow lets users enjoy audio discreetly while sleeping.

headline: After backlash, Meta pauses plan to ‘rate limit’ its smart glasses
summary: Meta has paused its controversial plan to charge for a smart glasses feature. The feature, which enhances voice clarity, runs locally on the device. Public backlash led to the company reversing its decision.

headline: Meta just created a moderation nightmare for its smart glasses
summary: Meta's smart glasses are facing significant privacy and surveillance concerns. Users are reportedly filming "prank" videos with the devices. Women are becoming unwitting subjects for social media content creators.

headline: Qualcomm is about to raise prices and that’s bad news for everyone
summary: Qualcomm plans to increase its prices by a double-digit percentage. These price hikes will affect products shipped after September 1st. The company attributes the rise to increased supplier costs and component shortages.

headline: Spaceballs: The New One Creators on Making Mel Brooks' Yogurt CGI and Paying Tribute to John Candy | Comic Con 2026
summary: Rick Moranis and Josh Gad unveiled details for 'Spaceballs: The New One' at SDCC. Mel Brooks' character Yogurt will now be a CGI creation. The film will feature new Star Wars gags and honor John Candy.

headline: God of War Laufey Release Date Announced | Comic Con 2026
summary: 'God of War Laufey' has an official release date. The game is set to launch on February 16, 2027. The announcement was made at Comic Con 2026.

headline: Next Kratos-Led God of War Game Is Coming After Laufey, and Connects Directly to Her Story | Comic Con 2026
summary: A new Kratos-led 'God of War' game is confirmed for after 'God of War Laufey'. The upcoming title will directly link to Laufey's story. Cory Barlog announced the news at Comic Con 2026.

headline: American Caper From Absurd Ventures' Dan Houser Is Getting a Double-Sized Season Finale Issue #12 - Exclusive | Comic Con 2026
summary: Dan Houser's 'American Caper' comic series will conclude with a double-sized finale. Issue #12 is scheduled for release on November 11, 2026. This exclusive news was revealed at Comic Con 2026.

headline: How the mystery of dead animals dumped in villages led to a hidden world of illegal hunts
summary: The dumping of dead animals uncovered a network of illegal hunts. Farmers have reported numerous attacks related to these activities. Police recorded nearly 9,000 incidents of banned hare coursing.

headline: Police declare 'major incident' over Cairngorms wildfire
summary: Police have declared a 'major incident' due to a wildfire in the Cairngorms. The blaze poses a threat to the village of Nethy Bridge. Some residents have evacuated their homes as a precaution.

headline: Trump takes swipes at press during White House Correspondents' Dinner
summary: Donald Trump criticized the press during the White House Correspondents' Dinner. The event traditionally celebrates press freedom. This year's dinner followed a cancellation due to an April shooting.

headline: Horror injury overshadows gymnastics silver for England at Commonwealths
summary: England secured a gymnastics team silver medal at the Glasgow 2026 Commonwealth Games. The achievement was overshadowed by a horrific fall from gymnast Gabriel Langton. The incident occurred during the opening night of action.
